inherited_obligations.requirement: All LUT addresses and configurations, with stated exhaustive or formal scope; include asymmetric and one-hot vectors.
Both reset values; enabled sampling; EN=0 dominates SR; no-edge and falling-edge hold; both ff output modes.
All eight binary 2-input mux cases; Nodal-only invalid 3-input selection rejection.
All twenty independent physical reference bindings, preservation while strobe low, padding behavior; legal and illegal semantic encodings.
Generated tile with actual upstream LUT/register source, generated switches/configmem, and both output modes; no Nodal fabrication claim.
Total pin/resource/config correspondence and all declared edges for one, square, odd and sparse shapes; missing/extra/reversed edges fail.
Nonvacuous witnesses reach q=0 and q=1, both mux selections, both ff modes, both reset values, and each declared link.
Reject X/Z stimulus and unknown post-initialization outputs; do not coerce unknown state to zero.
Swap I0/I3 address significance or corrupt one LUT INIT binding; asymmetric witness must detect.
Move SR above EN; EN=0 SR=1 opposite-q/reset_value witness must detect.
Invert mux select/input order; a0!=a1 witness must detect.
Shift frame bit mapping by one; per-bit binding witness must detect.
Swap mapped I0/I3 or omit a mapped output; correspondence check must fail independently of RTL.
Omit or reverse t00.e -> t10.w; topology and row behavior checks must detect.
Bind source and ff to same config bit without alias; reject overlapping ownership.

formal.label: A_LUT_ALL
formal.condition: O == INIT[I0 + 2*I1 + 4*I2 + 8*I3]; symbolic INIT and input; FF=carry=Ci=0

formal.label: H_REG_INIT_ONLY
formal.condition: !initialized -> EN && SR; initialized_0=0, first transition sets initialized=1; no DUT/shadow initial-q constraint

formal.label: A_REG_COMB
formal.condition: !FF -> O=independent LUT value; no initialization guard

formal.label: C_REG_R0
formal.condition: initialized && FF && reset_value=0 && previous EN=SR=1 && O=q_shadow=0

formal.label: C_REG_R1
formal.condition: initialized && FF && reset_value=1 && previous EN=SR=1 && O=q_shadow=1

formal.label: C_REG_CAPTURE
formal.condition: previous/current initialized && FF && previous EN=1 && previous SR=0 && q_shadow changes && O=q_shadow=previous d

formal.label: C_REG_HOLD_SR
formal.condition: previous/current initialized && FF && previous EN=0 && previous SR=1 && previous q_shadow!=reset_value && O=q_shadow=previous q_shadow=previous O

formal.label: C_REG_RESET
formal.condition: previous/current initialized && FF && previous EN=SR=1 && previous q_shadow!=reset_value && O=q_shadow=reset_value

execution_binding_requirements: Every planned ID binds actual harness relative path, declaration label, source line/span and SHA-256 after implementation.
Every formal ID binds its lowered cell and exported SMT function; reject lost, duplicate or unexpected cells and functions.
Every structural object binds actual compiled path/type/bit/direction and source line/span/hash; enumerate complete candidate inventory before exact-set comparison.
Every simulation record binds executed label, signal/time, expected/observed values and nonzero check count.
Every stage binds tested source/tree, immutable inputs, applicable ASM IDs, qualified profile/tool identities, exact command, actual result/counts and artifact hashes.
Actual observations remain separate; a planned denominator is never an executed count.

formal_timing.sample: state k immediately before rising edge k; q_k contains prior effects; d_k is current; edge k produces q_(k+1)
formal_timing.domain: INIT, reset_value and FF arbitrary stable binary constants; carry=0, Ci=0; EN, SR, inputs arbitrary binary after sample 0
formal_timing.export_guard: chformal -lower; exact assert/assume/cover counts; no $check; independent SMT function counts

oracle_independence: No generated RTL, production lowering, allocator, normalizer or observed consumer results may populate expectations.
configuration_mode: Non-EMULATION static/unit level-sensitive frame memory; UserCLK held low during setup; no runtime-loader qualification.
repeat_contract: Two fresh generation/config roots per shape; compare actual RTL/source-list hashes and semantic generation inventories; preserve path-bearing raw generation manifests locally without rewriting.
source_binding_state: pending implementation; required before execution acceptance
